name: jev-browser-control
description: Let Claude drive a real Chrome window: open pages, read them, click, type and fill in forms. Jev, a fast decision model, can run whole multi-step tasks at about half a second and a fraction of a cent per step. Logins you make in the window are kept, and clicks that buy, pay, send, post or delete wait for your OK.

jbc_api_key.title: Jev Browser Control key
jbc_api_key.description: Your jbc_ key from jevbrowsercontrol.com/dashboard (prepaid credits). Leave empty if you use your own OpenRouter key below, or keep keys in ~/.jev-browser-control/config.env.

openrouter_api_key.title: Or: your own OpenRouter key
openrouter_api_key.description: Run Jev on your own OpenRouter account instead of credits (sk-or-v1-...). Leave empty when you use a Jev Browser Control key.

ask_before_irreversible.title: Ask before buying, sending, posting or deleting
ask_before_irreversible.description: On: jev_task stops before clicks that buy, pay, send, post or delete, and Claude asks you. Off: such tasks run to the end without asking.
